newsitem.title: JAPAN: S&P ASSIGNS BBB TO ASAHI BANK PREFERRED SHARES.
newsitem.headline: S&P ASSIGNS BBB TO ASAHI BANK PREFERRED SHARES.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Corp said on Thursday it had assigned a BBB rating to the 50,000 units of AB International Cayman Trust, which represent the noncumulative mandatory convertible preference shares of Asahi Bank Ltd.
The units have a final mandatory conversion date of August 1, 2007, and are convertible at the option of the unit holders starting October 1, 1997, S&P said.
In addition, the units may be converted on October 1, 2005, and October 1, 2006, at the option of Asahi Bank, it said.
The units also may be converted at the option of Asahi Bank subject to the bank's common stock price level during a predetermined period, S&P said.
The credit rating of the units reflects the creditworthiness of preference shares issued by Asahi Bank, it said.
